<PAUSE>

<NAME_PLATE>

<NAME_PLATE>

<NAME_PLATE>男１

<PAUSE>
<NAME_PLATE>男２

<PAUSE>
<NAME_PLATE>男３

<PAUSE>
<NAME_PLATE>
